lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: two car flippers on winter ice fishing; the old one waits for a 'bite', the young one gets deals from a bot. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Lines: 1 lecturing, smug; 2 freezing, teeth chattering, stubborn; 3 excited shout; 4 deadpan, disappointed; 5 quiet, defeated question.

stas.profile: Stas — a calm, confident young Russian used-car flipper in his 30s, a bit cheeky.
stas.notes: Lines: 1 surprised and pleased; 2 thoughtful then amazed; 3 cheerful, walking up; 4 decisive, short; 5 friendly, slightly teasing.

palych.profile: Palych — an old cheerful Russian fisherman in his 70s, grey beard, husky warm village voice.
palych.notes: One line: surprised and amused, laughing a little.
